plugins.name: gtm-strategy
plugins.description: Cold-audit GTM strategy flow for IT agencies: 13 steps + orchestrator + a standalone 23-criteria GTM audit (stage -> ICP/market -> sizing -> competitor/GAP -> positioning -> value prop -> offers -> buyer journey -> materials/channels/docs -> 30-90-180 action plan). Outputs to Notion in Ukrainian. Plus 17 standalone marketing & operations tools (referrals, pricing, copywriting, CRO, SEO audit, analytics, RevOps, capacity plan, status report and more), copied with attribution from MIT/Apache-2.0 sources.
